2607.14753.title: Large Audio Language Models for Spoofing-Aware Speaker Verification
2607.14753.paper_summary: Recent advances in text-to-speech and voice cloning make high-quality spoofing inexpensive and scalable, threatening voice authentication systems, especially automatic speaker verification (ASV). Existing defenses mainly address this threat through binary countermeasures (CMs) for deepfake detection or spoofing-aware speaker verification (SASV), where current systems are dominated by modular ASV-CM fusion and cascaded pipelines. Although large audio language models (LALMs) have shown promise on related audio tasks, including CM and ASV, their use for SASV remains unexplored, despite their capacity to produce natural-language rationales for auditing and robustness beyond discriminative predictions. This work systematically evaluates LALMs for SASV against conventional pipelines under zero-shot prompting, supervised adaptation, reasoning-oriented training, and reinforcement-learning-based optimization. Our results show that pretrained LALMs are near chance in the zero-shot setting, confirming that they are not natively suited to SASV, but that task-specific adaptation closes this gap. We further find that competitive SASV performance can be achieved through several distinct routes. These findings position LALMs as a promising and auditable foundation for unified SASV, while clarifying where conventional cascade systems still lead.
2607.14753.paper_summary_zh: 最近在文本轉語音和聲音克隆方面的進展，使得高品質的欺騙變得便宜且可擴展，威脅到語音認證系統，特別是自動說話者驗證（ASV）。現有的防禦主要通過二元對策（CMs）來應對這一威脅，以進行深偽檢測或欺騙感知的說話者驗證（SASV），目前的系統主要由模塊化的ASV-CM融合和級聯管道主導。儘管大型音頻語言模型（LALMs）在相關音頻任務上顯示出潛力，包括CM和ASV，但它們在SASV中的應用仍未被探索，儘管它們能夠產生自然語言的理由以進行審計和超越判別預測的穩健性。本研究系統性地評估了LALMs在零樣本提示、監督適應、推理導向訓練和基於強化學習的優化下對SASV的表現，與傳統管道進行比較。我們的結果顯示，預訓練的LALMs在零樣本設置中接近隨機，確認它們並不適合SASV，但任務特定的適應縮小了這一差距。我們進一步發現，通過幾條不同的路徑可以實現具有競爭力的SASV性能。這些發現將LALMs定位為統一SASV的有前途且可審計的基礎，同時澄清了傳統級聯系統仍然領先的地方。
